pr_title: Fix DispatchProxy throwing TypeLoadException for static virtual members

issue_context.title: DispatchProxy throws TypeLoadException for static virtual members
issue_context.body:
### Description

It seems `DispatchProxyGenerator` was never updated to support C#11 static virtual members, it throws a `TypeLoadException` when used with an interface that contains any.

### Reproduction Steps

```
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <OutputType>Exe</OutputType>
    <TargetFramework>net9.0</TargetFramework>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
  </PropertyGroup>
</Project>
```

```C#
using System.Reflection;

DispatchProxy.Create<ITest, TestDispatchProxy>();

file interface ITest
{
    static virtual object? TestProperty { get; set; }

    static virtual void TestMethod() { }
}

file class TestDispatchProxy : DispatchProxy
{
    protected override object? Invoke(MethodInfo? targetMethod, object?[]? args)
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
}
```

### Expected behavior

A valid instance is created.

### Actual behavior

```
System.TypeLoadException
  HResult=0x80131522
  Message=Signature of the body and declaration in a method implementation do not match.  Type: 'generatedProxy_1'.  Assembly: 'ProxyBuilder, Version=0.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null'.
  Source=System.Private.CoreLib
  StackTrace:
   at System.Reflection.Emit.RuntimeTypeBuilder.CreateTypeNoLock()
   at System.Reflection.Emit.RuntimeTypeBuilder.CreateTypeInfoImpl()
   at System.Reflection.Emit.TypeBuilder.CreateType()
   at System.Reflection.DispatchProxyGenerator.ProxyBuilder.CreateType()
   at System.Reflection.DispatchProxyGenerator.ProxyAssembly.GenerateProxyType(Type baseType, Type interfaceType, String interfaceParameter, String proxyParameter)
   at System.Reflection.DispatchProxyGenerator.ProxyAssembly.GetProxyType(Type baseType, Type interfaceType, String interfaceParameter, String proxyParameter)
   at System.Reflection.DispatchProxyGenerator.CreateProxyInstance(Type baseType, Type interfaceType, String interfaceParameter, String proxyParameter)
   at System.Reflection.DispatchProxy.Create[T,TProxy]()
   at Program.<Main>$(String[] args) in Program.cs:line 3
```

review_comments: We also need tests that invoke the method and that verify that the proxy received correct values of the method arguments.

> We also need tests that invoke the method and that verify that the proxy received correct values of the method arguments.

Do you mean to test the result of e.g. this?
```C#
private static string TestStaticMethodInvocation<T>(T proxy, string argument)
    where T : TestType_IStaticVirtualMethodService
    => T.TestMethod(argument);
```
After all, the method cannot be invoked on the proxy instance itself since it's static.

Good point!

So what would be the behavior of calling `methodInfo.Invoke(...)` in this test case?

> Good point!
> 
> So what would be the behavior of calling `methodInfo.Invoke(...)` in this test case?

Unless I'm doing something wrong, this results in:
```
System.InvalidProgramException : Common Language Runtime detected an invalid program.
        Stack Trace:
             at generatedProxy_13.TestMethod(String)
             at InvokeStub_generatedProxy_13.TestMethod(Object, Span`1)
             at System.Reflection.MethodBaseInvoker.InvokeWithOneArg(Object obj, BindingFlags invokeAttr, Binder binder, Object[] parameters, CultureInfo culture)
```

Being able to call a static interface method on an instance of the interface should not be possible, so something like this seems expected.

The point is not to be able to call this method on the proxy instance but rather to be able to generate the proxy so one can call the non-static members of the interface, which is not possible atm since it fails to generate the proxy at all.

> Being able to call a static interface method on an instance of the interface should not be possible, so something like this seems expected.

This should throw `NotSupportedException` with a message like "DispatchProxy does not support Invocation of static virtual members." to make it clear that this is not supported currently.
